subject.title: fix(ui): add timeout to control-ui bootstrap config fetch

question: Should the Control UI silently abandon server-provided bootstrap metadata after 15 seconds when no caller cancellation signal is supplied?
rationale: The timeout improves availability but defines a compatibility boundary that can replace a slow valid server response with defaults; automated testing cannot choose the supported latency policy.

options.title: Accept 15-second fallback
options.body: Keep the patch after actual-app proof shows a usable fallback and the Control UI owner accepts the cutoff.

options.title: Select another deadline
options.body: Use an owner-approved timeout and prove both stalled fallback and a successful response near the chosen boundary.

options.title: Retain caller-only cancellation
options.body: Pause the implicit deadline until the product has a different explicit loading or recovery policy.

recommendation.title: Accept 15-second fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the patch after actual-app proof shows a usable fallback and the Control UI owner accepts the cutoff.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest available evidence of stewardship over the Control UI bootstrap endpoint and repository-wide compatibility decisions.
